column_rule: level k char of tile t is byte ((63h+k)*256 + t); FE = transparent (keep what is behind); FF terminates the column. A tile in window row y writes level k at row y-k; rows are processed top to bottom so nearer (lower) rows overwrite farther ones (routine 7E10).
height_class_rule: class = number of entries in the 7AC2 list that are <= t; height (levels) = class >> 1; odd classes are object tiles (crate/survivor/house/tree) standing on that height (7B03)
